name: torus-gland
why: The torus's main use — an O-ring gland — currently kills the worker, and this case keeps that visible rather than remembered. The boolean is fine; UnifySameDomain crashes on the coaxial seams it produces. Assertions are the bounding box and watertightness only, because a crashed part has no volume to record; when the crash is fixed this case starts passing, and a passing case still marked known_defect fails, so the marker cannot outlive the bug.

brep.known_defect: UnifySameDomain segfaults on the coaxial circular seams a torus groove leaves in a cylinder. Repro: cylinder(12, 14).cut(torus(11.5, 1)). See docs/GOTCHAS.md.
